subject: Post-call: BAA + SOC2 evidence and deploy-route preference for Safeguard Health
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Alex Parker <alex.parker@safeguardhealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@safeguardhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 02 May 2027 13:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap — BAA / SOC2 evidence and deploy-route preference

Hi Alex — thanks for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment on compliance gating and deployment options: 

Recap from our call:
- Safeguard is evaluating inference for PHI-enabled workflows and wants clarity on hosting options (Hosted API vs Dedicated GPU pool vs Private VPC/on-prem).
- Primary compliance asks: signed BAA, SOC2 Type II report, recent pen-test summary, and architecture details showing data flow and encryption-in-transit/at-rest controls.
- Procurement will run a brief security questionnaire and legal will want to redline our BAA.

Recommended next steps (my ask of you / Safeguard):
1) Share the security questionnaire you mentioned (Procurement).
2) Confirm whether you need data residency (US-only) or full customer-managed VPC. That will determine whether we propose Dedicated or Private deployment.
3) We will attach our current BAA (Redwood_BAA_v1.2.pdf) and SOC2 summary; internal ops will scope any architecture diagram you need.

Tentative timeline we discussed: you aim to complete vendor security review by 5/20 so we can lock procurement terms the week of 5/24.

Attachments I will include in the next message: Redwood_BAA_v1.2.pdf (for legal review) and a short SOC2 snapshot.

If helpful, we can schedule a 30-min security sync next week to walk through the attached evidence and start redlines.

Thanks — Jasmine
Jasmine Liu | Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0134

Attachment stub: Redwood_BAA_v1.2.pdf (pdf)

From: Alex Parker <alex.parker@safeguardhealth.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@safeguardhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — BAA / SOC2 evidence and deploy-route preference

Thanks Jasmine — that matches our notes. A few clarifications from Procurement: 

- We'll send the security questionnaire by EOD Tuesday (attached as the company form).
- Primary requirement: BAA must be in place. For hosting, Safeguard prefers Dedicated capacity in a US region for the initial pilot to avoid lengthy networking changes; Private VPC is a possibility after SOC & legal sign-off.
- One hard ask: we need a recent SOC2 Type II report (or an SSAE equivalent) and a brief description of how token-level logging/audit can be disabled for PHI in live traffic.

We'd appreciate an architecture diagram that shows where PHI touches Redwood systems and where it is stored or cached. Can you include an estimated timeline for Dedicated provisioning vs Private VPC onboarding?

Alex Parker
Director, Product Integrations — Safeguard Health
alex.parker@safeguardhealth.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Alex Parker <alex.parker@safeguardhealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 10:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — BAA / SOC2 evidence and deploy-route preference

Alex / team — quick notes from infra & compliance side: 

- SOC2: We can provide the Type II report under NDA; if you want an executive summary first, we can share a redacted snapshot in 24 hours.
- Token-level logging: for Dedicated we can disable ingestion-level logging for PHI by configuration and provide audit logs only for operational metadata (no content). We will document exact log-retention settings for your security team.
- Deployment timeline (estimate):
  * Hosted API (no PHI): minutes to integrate — not applicable here.
  * Dedicated (US region, reserved pool): provisioning ~7 business days after contract and infra checklist sign-off.
  * Private VPC (customer-managed networking or on‑prem): initial onboarding ~6–8 weeks (network, MDM/KMS setup, HSM options).

Recommendation: proceed with Dedicated capacity for the pilot (meets your short timeline and keeps PHI isolated); plan Private VPC as phase 2 if you require full network control or on-prem HSM. We'll bake this into the mutual action plan.

I'll attach a bulletized evidence list we can deliver immediately for your security review.

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Head of Infra Programs, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

Immediate deliverables (within 48 business hours / on NDA):
- Redacted SOC2 Type II executive summary (PDF)

For procurement/legal: please confirm the preferred contact for redlines and whether you require a signed BAA pre-production. Also indicate if you need any CA/BCA attestation documents for our cloud partners.

If everything looks right, Jasmine — can you propose a 30-min security sync for 5/10 or 5/11 to walk through the artifacts? I'll own the evidence delivery.

Best — Grace
